summary: Voidscar Arena combines a route-defining secondary-stat choice with priority stops and spatial boss mechanics.
actions: Interrupt Demoralizing Shout, Shadowbolt Volley, Violent Sand, Mad Shriek, and Mending Void.
Remove Melt Armor and Corrosive Essence; treat Mind-Numbing Poison as recovery after a failed mechanic and purge Bolster.
Choose the opening path deliberately: the left path grants a 30-minute Versatility bonus and the right path grants a 30-minute Mastery bonus.
Face Brutok into a wall, burst the Protective Turtle during its vulnerable window, and kill a Devouring Brutalizer's selected victim before the enemy can heal.
On Charonus, assign singularities with pings and kite Gravitic Orbs into the chosen singularity.
